  2. Confirm reservations with buyers via the 1-Click WhatsApp button in your CRM.
  3. Order the item on AliExpress & paste the tracking number.
  4. Collect cash on delivery (Yalidine / ZR Express) & mark Delivered!

📜 Full 2-Way Backend Google Apps Script (Serves Products to Client Site + Receives Orders)

In your Odette — Clients & Orders Database Google Sheet, click Extensions → Apps Script, paste this code, and click Deploy → New Deployment → Web App (Who has access: Anyone).

// ODETTE 2-WAY CLOUD BACKEND (Google Sheets + Apps Script)
// 1. Serves live Products & Store Settings to your public Client Website (doGet)
// 2. Receives new Client Reservations & Admin Catalog Publishes (doPost)

function doGet(e) {
  var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var catalogJson = props.getProperty("ODETTE_PUBLIC_CATALOG") || "[]";
  var configJson = props.getProperty("ODETTE_STORE_CONFIG") || "{}";
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName("Clients & Orders Database") || ss.getActiveSheet();
  var rows = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  var orders = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (!rows[i][0]) continue;
    orders.push({
      id: String(rows[i][0]), date: String(rows[i][1]), customer: String(rows[i][2]),
      phone: String(rows[i][3]), city: String(rows[i][4]), address: String(rows[i][5]),
      social: String(rows[i][6]), itemsSummary: String(rows[i][7]),
      totalQty: Number(rows[i][8] || 1), totalUsd: Number(rows[i][9] || 0),
      totalDzd: Number(rows[i][10] || 0), status: String(rows[i][11] || "Pending"),
      notes: String(rows[i][12] || "")
    });
  }
  var payload = {
    status: "ok",
    products: JSON.parse(catalogJson),
    config: JSON.parse(configJson),
    orders: orders.reverse()
  };
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(payload)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  var data = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (data.action === "publish_catalog") {
    // Strip private supplierCost before exposing to public clients
    var cleanProducts = (data.products || []).map(function(p) {
      var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p));
      delete copy.supplierCost;
      return copy;
    });
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty("ODETTE_PUBLIC_CATALOG", JSON.stringify(cleanProducts));
    if (data.config) {
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty("ODETTE_STORE_CONFIG", JSON.stringify(data.config));
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status: "catalog_published", count: cleanProducts.length})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName("Clients & Orders Database") || ss.getActiveSheet();
  sheet.appendRow([
    data.id || ("ORD-" + Math.floor(Math.random()*9000+1000)),
    data.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),
    data.customer || "", data.phone || "", data.city || "", data.address || "",
    data.social || "", data.itemsSummary || "", data.totalQty || 1,
    data.totalUsd || 0, data.totalDzd || 0, data.status || "Pending", data.notes || ""
  ]);
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status: "order_saved"})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
